fact: Cabinet notes the Internet Gratis measure for Social Register of Mauritius households is operational, with a State Informatics platform letting the three internet service providers verify whether an applicant is on the SRM database.

Cabinet records Internet Gratis (over 7,000 families, nearly 31,000 persons, Rs85 million a year) and a wastewater-fee exemption for subscribers of six cubic metres or less as both keyed to the Social Register of Mauritius.

The Social Integration Division reports that for FY2024-2025 7,336 households (28,722 beneficiaries) eligible on the SRM drew the Subsistence Allowance and other schemes (crèche allowance, diaper grant, school materials grant, tertiary fee waiver).
